head: 6ed9ace3a92f7435f84c2f75f0084a03070ae2e4
scope: Unresolved semantic decisions discovered in MOB-0/MOB-1. This register records evidence and does not approve a canonical contract or implementation change.

decisions.title: Branch, store, stall, booth, and kiosk mapping
decisions.context: The mobile schema uses Branch as the entity while branch_type contains several physical operating formats.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: branches.branch_type defaults to stall and accepts a TypeScript union of stall, branch, kiosk, booth, home kitchen, and pop-up.
decisions.ambiguity: It is not established whether every Branch is a future Stall, whether store is a business type, or whether some values require separate canonical concepts.
potentialCanonicalOptions: retain Branch and add operating-format subtype
decisions.dataLossRisk: High if distinct mobile values collapse into one untagged canonical term.
decisions.migrationRisk: Medium; existing rows require a reversible mapping.
decisions.offlineImpact: Local queries and activeBranchId settings depend on current IDs and terminology.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Shared Contracts and all consumers need the same location identity and subtype rules.
decisions.recommendation: Treat stall as a future direction only; preserve legacy Branch and branch_type in compatibility evidence until approved.

decisions.title: Local identifiers and future cloud identity
decisions.context: Most records use application-generated TEXT IDs with time and Math.random components; problem reports use a UUID-derived form.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: makeLocalId emits local_<kind>_<base36 time>_<six random chars>; SQLite primary keys are TEXT.
decisions.ambiguity: Collision handling, device namespace, export stability, remote IDs, and canonical ID ownership are undefined.
potentialCanonicalOptions: add server ID while retaining local ID
decisions.dataLossRisk: High if collisions or ID replacement break foreign-key history.
decisions.migrationRisk: High; identifiers connect 60 foreign keys and JSON queue payloads.
decisions.offlineImpact: Offline creation must remain possible before any server assignment.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Every cross-system entity reference depends on the choice.
decisions.recommendation: Keep current IDs immutable and model any future canonical or server identity as an explicit compatibility decision.

decisions.title: UTC instants, local business dates, and business timezone
decisions.context: Operational timestamps are normally UTC ISO strings while grocery and fixed-cost dates are local YYYY-MM-DD values.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: nowIso and service writers use Date.toISOString; purchase_date, due_date, start_date, end_date, and fixed payment dates are date-only strings.
decisions.ambiguity: No IANA business timezone is stored and SQLite does not enforce formats.
potentialCanonicalOptions: UTC instant plus Asia/Manila business timezone
UTC instant plus per-business IANA timezone
decisions.dataLossRisk: High if date-only values are reinterpreted as UTC instants.
decisions.migrationRisk: High for historical report boundaries and mixed-format legacy rows.
decisions.offlineImpact: Device timezone currently influences date construction and report windows.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Shared date/time types and report period semantics must agree.
decisions.recommendation: Distinguish Instant from LocalDate and require an approved business-timezone rule without rewriting legacy values.

decisions.title: PHP money representation, precision, and rounding
decisions.context: SQLite REAL and JavaScript number represent prices, costs, discounts, payments, and report aggregates.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: businesses.currency defaults to PHP; monetary columns are REAL; no systematic minor-unit scale or calculation rounding was found.
decisions.ambiguity: Centavo precision, accepted decimal scale, negative values, and canonical rounding stage are not specified.
decisions.dataLossRisk: High if binary floating-point values are rounded or converted without a reversible policy.
decisions.migrationRisk: High across every accounting aggregate.
decisions.offlineImpact: All local calculations currently use JavaScript number.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Shared Contracts must define money units without silently changing mobile results.
decisions.recommendation: Record legacy PHP REAL semantics explicitly; decide canonical minor units and rounding only with reconciliation tests.

decisions.title: Quantity precision, unit vocabulary, and conversions
decisions.context: Product and ingredient quantities use SQLite REAL and JavaScript number with two different unit vocabularies.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: UnitType has nine values; IngredientUnit has six; services generally require exact unit compatibility and expose no general conversion engine.
decisions.ambiguity: Allowed scale and rounding, whether the current exact kg↔g and L↔ml factors become canonical, pack-size meaning, and cross-vocabulary equivalence are undefined.
potentialCanonicalOptions: retain source unit and optional conversion metadata
decisions.dataLossRisk: High if quantities are rounded or units are collapsed.
decisions.migrationRisk: High for stock and COGS reconciliation.
decisions.offlineImpact: Current deductions rely on stored numeric values and exact unit assumptions.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: All inventory-related contracts need a common but lossless representation.
decisions.recommendation: Preserve source quantity and unit; defer conversions until business-approved rules and fixtures exist.

decisions.title: Finished-product stock and lifetime-average production COGS
decisions.context: Finished products have scalar stock_qty rather than lots; production COGS is derived from recorded production history.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: production increments products.stock_qty and checkout can use a production-average cost; no finished-product lot table exists.
decisions.ambiguity: The intended costing horizon, handling of unsold units, and future lot-level traceability are not specified.
potentialCanonicalOptions: retain scalar stock with lifetime average
decisions.dataLossRisk: High if historical COGS is recomputed under a different costing method.
decisions.migrationRisk: High because past batches are not allocated to exact sold units.
decisions.offlineImpact: Checkout needs a locally computable cost even without cloud state.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Sale-line cost provenance must preserve the Android source and estimated flag.
decisions.recommendation: Treat the stored sale-line COGS snapshot as authoritative legacy evidence; do not infer finished-product lots.

decisions.title: Ingredient lot selection versus FIFO depletion
decisions.context: Recipes and production can retain a selected ingredient lot; the implementation does not establish FIFO.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: recipe_ingredient_lines stores ingredient_lot_id and cost snapshots; production deducts the selected lot with guarded updates.
decisions.ambiguity: Whether users must always select a lot, how an unavailable selected lot should fall back, and whether future FIFO is allowed are unresolved.
decisions.dataLossRisk: High if future processing silently reallocates historical usage to different lots.
decisions.migrationRisk: Medium; usage rows already carry lot snapshots where available.
decisions.offlineImpact: Local operations must resolve lot availability without a server.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Contract commands must distinguish user-selected lot from policy-selected lot.
decisions.recommendation: Name current behavior selected-lot, not FIFO, until a policy is approved.

decisions.title: Deletion, tombstone, archive, and full-reset semantics
decisions.context: Twenty-two tables contain deleted_at, but normal code does not set it; archival uses status or active flags and pilot reset hard-deletes all app records.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: No non-null deleted_at writer was found; reset deletes 23 application tables and preserves schema_migrations.
decisions.ambiguity: Future deletion authority, tombstone retention, report inclusion, and synchronization of deletion are undefined.
potentialCanonicalOptions: immutable accounting records plus compensating events
decisions.dataLossRisk: Critical if hard deletion or archive filtering removes accounting and stock evidence.
decisions.migrationRisk: High because current deleted_at fields do not prove current semantics.
decisions.offlineImpact: Offline deletions require durable intent and conflict behavior.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Shared Contracts must not equate null deleted_at with an approved deletion model.
decisions.recommendation: Preserve current fields as legacy metadata and decide lifecycle per entity before sync work.

decisions.title: Owner alert open versus active legacy status
decisions.context: SQLite defaults owner alerts to open while the TypeScript type uses active and resolved.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: owner_alerts.status default is open; OwnerAlertStatus is active | resolved; repository read logic accommodates current values.
decisions.ambiguity: Whether open and active are synonyms, sequential states, or a legacy defect is not approved.
decisions.dataLossRisk: Medium if legacy open alerts disappear from active queries.
decisions.migrationRisk: Low to medium, but requires production-data evidence.
decisions.offlineImpact: Existing local rows may retain open indefinitely.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Canonical status parsing must accept or explicitly map legacy values.
decisions.recommendation: Keep both values in the compatibility vocabulary until live-data distribution is inspected.

decisions.title: Seller identity and sale attribution
decisions.context: The product has owner and kiosk modes but no persisted seller, user, shift, or actor ID.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: sales has business and optional branch references but no seller; kiosk shift state is in-memory.
decisions.ambiguity: The future actor model, membership, device identity, and attribution of historical sales are undefined.
decisions.dataLossRisk: High if legacy sales are falsely attributed to a user.
decisions.migrationRisk: High because historical attribution cannot be reconstructed from current rows.
decisions.offlineImpact: Seller actions must remain possible offline and be attributable after reconnect.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Authentication and sales contracts depend on actor and membership semantics.
decisions.recommendation: Represent current records as unattributed legacy actions; do not synthesize seller identity.
decisions.blockingMilestone: MOB-2 actor contracts before authentication design

decisions.title: Offline queue event shape and lifecycle
decisions.context: Checkout appends a pending sale payload to offline_queue, but no worker consumes or updates it.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: offline_queue stores entity_type, operation, JSON payload, status, attempt_count, last_error, and sync_status; checkout is the only active producer found.
decisions.ambiguity: Payload versioning, retry rules, idempotency, terminal states, ordering, and deletion are undefined.
decisions.dataLossRisk: Critical if queued sales are dropped, duplicated, or interpreted under a changed payload shape.
decisions.migrationRisk: High because existing JSON has no declared version.
decisions.offlineImpact: This is the primary future offline handoff boundary.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Backend and Shared Contracts need an exact versioned event/command schema.
decisions.recommendation: Freeze and inspect the current payload shape before any consumer; specify versioning and idempotency first.

decisions.title: Sync revision, conflict, device, and remote metadata
decisions.context: Rows expose sync_status, updated_at, and deleted_at, but no server ID, revision, device ID, conflict record, or synced_at exists.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: Current writers use local or pending; no code writes synced or failed.
decisions.ambiguity: Conflict authority, clock ordering, version vectors, retry identity, and per-device ownership are wholly undefined.
potentialCanonicalOptions: client mutation ID plus server version
decisions.dataLossRisk: Critical if last-write-wins is assumed without domain approval.
decisions.migrationRisk: High because adding metadata must preserve current offline rows.
decisions.offlineImpact: Conflicts arise precisely because local writes continue while disconnected.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Requires coordinated mobile, backend, and Shared Contracts protocols.
decisions.recommendation: Defer implementation; decide envelope and conflict semantics after MOB-2 evidence mappings.

decisions.title: Sale cancellation, refund, and reversal representation
decisions.context: Sales and stock movements are created, but no cancellation, refund, void, or compensating transaction model was found.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: sales.payment_status includes states, yet checkout creates sales without a later lifecycle service; reports filter existing records rather than reversal events.
decisions.ambiguity: Financial reversal, stock restoration, payment refund, and report treatment are unspecified.
potentialCanonicalOptions: void status with linked stock reversal
decisions.dataLossRisk: Critical if deletion is used as a future substitute for reversal.
decisions.migrationRisk: High; no existing relation can encode a full reversal.
decisions.offlineImpact: Reversal commands require offline idempotency and causal links.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Sales, payments, inventory, and accounting contracts must agree.
decisions.recommendation: Do not infer cancellation from payment_status or deleted_at; define explicit compensating semantics.

decisions.title: Fixed-cost payment occurrence uniqueness
decisions.context: The service checks for an existing fixed-cost payment by due date before insert, but SQLite has no matching unique constraint and the operation is not one atomic write.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: fixed_cost_payments has an ordinary fixed_cost_id index; repository logic performs read-before-write duplicate prevention.
decisions.ambiguity: The business key, branch participation, paid versus skipped replacement, and conflict behavior are not formalized.
decisions.dataLossRisk: High because duplicates can double-count or conflict across devices.
decisions.migrationRisk: Medium; existing duplicates would need evidence-led reconciliation.
decisions.offlineImpact: Concurrent offline devices can create the same occurrence.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: A canonical occurrence identity is required for synchronization.
decisions.recommendation: Define an occurrence identity before cloud synchronization; do not add a constraint during discovery.

decisions.title: Cook-upon-order best-effort ingredient deduction
decisions.context: Cook-upon-order checkout deliberately does not block a sale for ingredient shortfall and stores estimated usage, but the guarded lot update result is not checked before history rows are inserted.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: Checkout plans shortages, marks estimated COGS and shortfall, and uses an exclusive transaction; prepared products have stricter stock guards.
decisions.ambiguity: Whether failed lot deduction with recorded usage is intended audit behavior or a defect is unresolved.
potentialCanonicalOptions: record requested versus deducted quantities separately
decisions.dataLossRisk: High because stock and usage history can diverge.
decisions.migrationRisk: Medium; historical rows may not reveal whether deduction succeeded.
decisions.offlineImpact: Local availability can change between planning and transaction execution.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Contracts need explicit actual, estimated, and shortfall meanings.
decisions.recommendation: Escalate for domain review before specifying sale ingredient usage; preserve current behavior meanwhile.

decisions.title: Fixed-cost archival and historical report inclusion
decisions.context: Profit report occurrence generation selects active fixed costs, so archiving can remove a cost from later calculations of historical periods.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: fixed_costs.status becomes archived; profit report queries active rows when deriving period occurrences.
decisions.ambiguity: Whether archive should affect only future periods or all recomputed periods is undefined.
potentialCanonicalOptions: include archived costs for dates before archive
decisions.dataLossRisk: High because a historical net-profit result can change without a transaction change.
decisions.migrationRisk: High; no archived_at/effective end is recorded unless end_date was set separately.
decisions.offlineImpact: Reports are recomputed locally from current rows.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Canonical reports need stable period semantics.
decisions.recommendation: Treat current computed result as implementation behavior, not approved accounting meaning; decide effective dating before mapping.

decisions.title: Legacy recipe_batches versus ingredient-backed production_batches
decisions.context: Two separate batch concepts coexist: a legacy cooked-batch log and the newer production batch with ingredient usages.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: recipe_batches stores recipe name, servings, and total cost; production_batches links recipe/output and has production_ingredient_usages.
decisions.ambiguity: Whether they represent the same canonical entity, distinct workflows, or a legacy migration boundary is not established.
potentialCanonicalOptions: legacy compatibility record mapped to a partial production batch
decisions.dataLossRisk: High if legacy batches are upgraded with invented ingredient details.
decisions.migrationRisk: High because relations and required fields differ.
decisions.offlineImpact: Both datasets may exist locally and must remain readable.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Shared Contracts needs an explicit legacy mapping or separate shapes.
decisions.recommendation: Keep them separate in evidence until product ownership confirms intended convergence.

decisions.title: Sale-level discount and line-level allocation
decisions.context: Sales store a header discount and sale items store discount_amount, while checkout line totals and reporting use stored snapshots.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: Live checkout stores the cart-level discount on sales.discount and currently writes 0 to every sale_items.discount_amount.
decisions.ambiguity: Allocation rules, rounding remainder, bundle interaction, and reconciliation between header and lines are not declared as a shared invariant.
potentialCanonicalOptions: both with a required reconciliation equation
decisions.dataLossRisk: High if contracts recompute or reallocate legacy amounts.
decisions.migrationRisk: Medium; historical row totals are already snapshots.
decisions.offlineImpact: Local checkout must calculate deterministically without a server.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Receipts, reporting, and server ingestion need identical total semantics.
decisions.recommendation: Preserve both fields and document the current algorithm before approving a canonical allocation rule.

decisions.title: Authorization, ownership, and membership enforcement
decisions.context: Owner PIN and biometric checks gate owner UI transitions, but repositories and services accept no actor, role, or membership context.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: Owner access is stored in SecureStore and mirrored in Zustand; exported reset and mutation services rely on callers for authorization.
decisions.ambiguity: Future role permissions, business membership, device trust, and service-layer enforcement are undefined.
decisions.dataLossRisk: Critical if cloud commands trust UI-only mode without authorization.
decisions.migrationRisk: High because records have no current actor or membership foreign key.
decisions.offlineImpact: Offline authorization must balance local continuity and eventual server enforcement.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Authentication, Platform API, and Shared Contracts all depend on the model.
decisions.recommendation: Do not add authentication in MOB-1; require a separate approved threat and role model.
decisions.blockingMilestone: Authentication and cloud-connectivity design after MOB-2

decisions.title: App-setting absence, null, empty, and typed-value semantics
decisions.context: app_settings stores non-null text values plus value_type; a missing row is distinct from stored empty, zero, false, or JSON null-like content.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: The repository reads by unique key and upserts serialized values; TypeScript has fixed and dynamic keys.
decisions.ambiguity: Canonical null behavior, invalid JSON handling, unknown keys, deletion, and defaults are not uniformly specified.
decisions.dataLossRisk: Medium if missing and explicit false/empty values are collapsed.
decisions.migrationRisk: Medium for parsing legacy string values.
decisions.offlineImpact: Settings currently remain fully local and bootstrap behavior depends on absence.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Contracts must decide which settings cross repositories at all.
decisions.recommendation: Classify each key as local-only or shared and preserve absence separately from explicit values.

decisions.title: Transfer destination product identity and merge semantics
decisions.context: A transfer looks up a destination product by business, branch, and exact product name, then reuses it or clones a destination row.
decisions.currentAndroidEvidence: The lookup occurs before the exclusive transaction; product name is not unique and the destination update does not validate product type or unit compatibility.
decisions.ambiguity: It is undefined whether same-name products are the same inventory identity, whether category/type/unit must match, and how concurrent creation is resolved.
potentialCanonicalOptions: explicit destination product ID selected by the user
canonical product/catalog identity with branch stock records
decisions.dataLossRisk: High if quantities or cost are merged into the wrong same-name product.
decisions.migrationRisk: High because current transfer history snapshots names but may not preserve a durable shared catalog identity.
decisions.offlineImpact: Concurrent offline transfers can create or target competing destination products.
decisions.crossRepositoryImpact: Product identity, branch stock, and transfer contracts must agree before synchronization.
decisions.recommendation: Preserve current transfer evidence and require an approved destination-identity rule; do not infer name equality as canonical identity.
decisions.blockingMilestone: MOB-2 transfer and product identity contracts
